parts.gloss: to yield or give birth to

literal: The infant called grace, yielded by love, is sustained by the precious foster-mother called wealth.
translation: The child called compassion, born of love, is nurtured and sustained by the bountiful foster-mother called wealth.
modern: அன்பு பெற்றெடுத்த அருள் என்னும் குழந்தையானது, பொருள் என்னும் வளமையான செவிலித்தாயால் வளர்க்கப்பட்டு உயிர்வாழும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a beautiful family metaphor to explain the practical necessity of wealth. Compassion (அருள்) is described as a child born to the mother called love (அன்பு). However, just as a newborn child needs a foster-mother (செவிலி) to feed and nurture it so it can grow, compassion cannot survive or be put into practice in the real world without the support of material wealth (பொருள்). Thus, wealth is essential to sustain and realize one's compassionate intentions.
